openings.claim: A provenance-linked common-unit ledger may resolve discrepancies left bounded by separate conversion and revision checks. Carry original row identifiers through normalization; only explicit supersession links select replacements. Preserve duplicates and unmatched rows. Equal normalized quantities cannot identify an older differently identified row as the replacement.
openings.discriminator: Against merely additive independent checks, predict R(intact)-R(A)-R(B)+R(baseline)>0 in correct resolved-batch counts and fewer correct resolutions with the row-ID interface broken, without increasing unsupported definite claims. Defeat coupling if interaction is nonpositive, breaking the interface does not reduce correctness, or benefits require unsupported identity matching.
openings.probe: Propose one script with five frozen views of identical records: baseline retaining raw rows; A using only supplied U-to-V conversion; B registering explicit replacements without conversion; intact A×B; link-broken A×B retaining both parent contents but withholding their row-ID interface. Run clean and disturbed copies (missing supersession reference; undefined status). Freeze twelve-batch outputs with citations and at most three field-specific requests before opening the sealed key. Compare resolved counts, unsupported claims and requests within twenty extra minutes. Record setup and maintenance time, including amendment-link repair and undefined-status handling; actual review stays within sixty minutes.
openings.uncertainty: Effects are proposed, unmeasured; the awkward pre-cutoff amendment/replacement under another identifier may remain unresolved. Actual records and setup time are unavailable; five-view construction and comparison capacity are unverified. Missing supersession or undefined status means explicit bounded disagreement and, if prioritized, a request naming that field. Never infer quantities from neighboring batches. If setup or comparison exceeds budgets, the probe is infeasible; do not extend budgets.

lineage.reason: Retains causal coupling, additive rival, all defeat conditions, five-view comparison, uncertainty, declared uncertain fit and resource stopping caveat.

decision: Retain one unmeasured hypothesis. For every batch, report reconciled quantity or bounded disagreement with supporting records; preserve rows, use only supplied conversion, cap field-specific follow-ups at three, and verify feasibility within fixed budgets.
